g.text: Panel: J1-J4 jack in (1 tip, 2 GND); J11-J41 pot (1 CCW=GND, 2 wiper, 3 CW=jack); J5, J6 jack out.

g.desc: Panel: J1-J4 jack in (1 tip, 2 GND); J11-J41 pot (1 CCW=GND, 2 wiper, 3 CW=jack); J5, J6 jack out.

g.text: Soft limiter: 4.7k + 2 x 4 red LEDs (antiparallel) across R6: round from about 6 V, towards +-7.5 V. Hierarchical OUT_INV for on-board use.

g.desc: Soft limiter: 4.7k + 2 x 4 red LEDs (antiparallel) across R6: round from about 6 V, towards +-7.5 V. Hierarchical OUT_INV for on-board use.

g.text: Unity per channel at full level; DC-coupled (CV and audio). IN_AUX: an on-board signal at unity. Outputs 1k.

g.desc: Unity per channel at full level; DC-coupled (CV and audio). IN_AUX: an on-board signal at unity. Outputs 1k.

g.text: mix-4ch: IN1-4 -> LEVEL pots (B100K) -> 100k -> inverting sum (Rf 100k) -> inverter -> OUT; OUT_INV from the summer

g.desc: mix-4ch: IN1-4 -> LEVEL pots (B100K) -> 100k -> inverting sum (Rf 100k) -> inverter -> OUT; OUT_INV from the summer
